content:
elaine: Quick sync — Cosmos silicon preview. We need to lock NDA staging, bench cadence, and feedback loop. Alex (Cosmos) will join in a bit.

sam: Got it. Are we using their partner rack or our sandbox lab? Need access creds if partner rack.

elaine: Plan proposal: 2-week EAP starting Mon 5/6. Non-prod dataset only. Runs: microbench (latency/throughput) + prompt-quality evals. NDA draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/eap/cosmos/nda-v1.pdf. @legal please confirm signature status.

marta: I can own the benchmarks. Need model list, typical seq lengths, perf targets, and whether we can collect power traces. Also want to push our bench agent to their rack for consistent telemetry.

jordan: Infra notes: Cosmos will provide an SSH jump host + docker images. We must use ephemeral keys and no customer data on the preview. Can Alex confirm kernel version? Some of our optimized kernels have issues on newer kernels.

sam: I'll draft a short checklist and runbook: 1) NDA signed 2) lab creds + jump host 3) bench harness + config 4) telemetry hooks (nvidia-smi, telegraf) 5) feedback cadence (weekly + async).

elaine: Alex, can you confirm jump host name, kernel, and availability windows? Also we need per-run logs and flamegraphs exported.

alex (Cosmos): Confirmed: jump host cosmos-jump-1.cosmos.net, available 09:00-17:00 PT next week. Kernel initially 5.15, can schedule 6.x test later. NDA signed by Cosmos legal and uploaded to your Drive link. We'll provide a small ops contact (Rina) on day 1.

marta: Benchmark command prototype:
```
./perf-run.sh --model redwood/small --batch 8 --seq 2048 --runs 100 --log ./out.json
```
Collect p50/p95/p99 latencies, throughput (tokens/sec), memory waterfall, and GPU power traces (1s granularity). We should also capture KV cache stats for long prompt runs.

jordan: Add infra caveat: if kernel != 5.15 we need a quick smoke to validate fused attention kernels. I'll add a smoke test to the runbook.

sam: I'll add nvidia-smi logging + telegraf and push a lightweight collector to the jump host. Will also create ephemeral IAM creds for S3 with 24h TTL for the run artifacts. Link to repo with runbook: https://github.com/redwood/eng-bench/tree/main/cosmos-preview

elaine: Feedback loop: weekly sync + a dedicated async thread in #partnerships for day-to-day notes. Canary run on day 2 (small sample). Full sweep day 7. Postmortem/feedback doc 2 days after full run. Any blockers?

marta: Need quant config from Research for the quantized variants we'll test. @research-team can you share the profile (bit-width, per-channel layout) and expected regressions?

jordan: Also enforce rollback policy: if perf regresses >10% vs baseline we'll automatically fallback to the quantized variant v1 or reduce batch size. Add alerting to the run script.

sam: Drafted a short runbook checklist and pushed it. Also added a quick 'how to reproduce' for the bench agent. Will DM infra keys to Alex once NDA is verified.

deploy-bot: bench-harness deploy started by sam at 2065432130 — logs: https://builds.redwood.internal/bench/2065432130

elaine: Thanks — I'll update the timeline and send a calendar invite for kickoff with Alex + Rina + ops + bench leads. :raised_hands:

alex (Cosmos): Looking forward. We'll have Rina (ops) and Priya (HW validation) on the call day 1. If you need extra traces (PCIe counters), let me know and we can enable them for the full sweep.

elaine: Great — baseline actions: Sam to circulate runbook, Marta to prepare bench configs, Jordan to add smoke tests, legal to confirm NDA signature. We'll reconvene after Alex confirms jump host connectivity.

sam: On it. Expect runbook v1 by EOD.

marta: I'll upload the 100-prompt eval set to the drive tonight.

jordan: Adding a health-check script to the repo.

elaine: Closing the loop — please keep updates in this thread and ping me for any escalations.
